messages:
Dana: quick postmortem follow-up: we're still seeing recurring OOMs tied to KV residency growth on a subset of shards (notably shard-7). Need to lock owners, timeline, and concrete remediation steps.
Bob: +1. Observed residency drift after long-tail requests. suspect slab fragmentation + small hot allocations.
Erin: can you paste the last heap snapshot and the telemetry query?
Dana: pasted heatmap and a short query below. heatmap shows spike at 03:14 UTC and steady growth after a tail of small writes. query: `sum(kv_residency_bytes) by (shard)` since 03:00
Carla: I ran a quick pprof on a repro node — attached gif in thread (uploader). seeing lots of many small allocations in allocator arena 2.
Mike: initial idea: enable slab coalescing + bump eviction aggressiveness for the problematic shards. also probe fragmentation using `kv/frag-signature` metric.
Bob: agree on coalescing. We should be careful: previous coalescing rollout caused a latency regression in 1% tail. Need canary first.
Dana: plan suggestion: 1) capture full heap + two incremental pprofs (now, +4h) 2) run a canary with slab coalescing on 2 nodes 3) tune GC thresholds and limit per-shard residency (soft limit) 4) alert on frag-signature delta > 15%
Erin: can we get the commands for heap captures?
Carla: put this in runbook: ```
# capture heap
curl -sS http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/heap > /tmp/heap-$(date +%s).pprof
# pprof top
pprof -top /usr/bin/service /tmp/heap-*.pprof
```
Bob: also enable continuous small-allocation profiling: set `alloc_trace_interval=30s` in runtime config for the canary only.
infra-bot: Added runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-frag-signature-detection (owners: Dana, Bob) :bookmark: 
oncall-bot: Noted. Current oncall: Carla until 04/05.
Mike: ownership proposal: Dana = overall PM/triage lead, Bob = runtime owner (implementation + canary), Carla = observability + oncall followups, Erin = profiling/triage owner. Timeline: start canary tomorrow 09:00 PDT, 72h observation window, rollback criteria: tail latency > 5% or memory growth rate > baseline + 20%.
Dana: assigning action items: A1: heap captures + upload to artifacts (Erin) — due EOD today. A2: canary config and slot reservation (Bob) — due start of day tomorrow. A3: dashboard with frag-signature and per-shard residency + alert (Carla) — due tomorrow 08:30 PDT. A4: runbook checklist update and rollback steps (Dana) — due today 17:00 PDT.
Erin: working on A1 now. I'll attach pprof links once uploaded.
Carla: will create Grafana panel and alert. Which aggregation? per-shard 5m avg?
Bob: 1m for fast detection, but alert on sustained 5m window. set evaluation window 10m.
Dana: checklist note: include a mitigator of draining shard to spare pool and force eviction if limit reached. add command: `kvctl drain-shard --shard=7 --force-evict`
Mike: recurring pattern note: this last 3 incidents share: long-running tail requests, small-object churn, and increased co-located jobs on those nodes. Suggest a periodic review cadence (biweekly) to monitor drift.
Bob: devops item: add a guardrail that auto-limits new allocations to shard when frag-signature > threshold, emit a high-severity alert.
Carla: I'll make the alert noisy for first 48h then silence if false positives.
Dana: quick risk callout: eviction and forcing coalescing can increase CPU; watch P95 CPU of the canary nodes and set autoscaler buffer.
Erin: uploaded three pprof artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/dana/pprof/2791234000/heap1.pprof (now), heap2.pprof (+4h), heap3.pprof (+8h)
Bob: will start canary config tonight on staging and request slot for prod tomorrow 09:00 PDT.
infra-bot: Canary slot reserved: prod-kv-canary-12, window 2791310400 - 2791569600.
Dana: closing notes: owners and timelines confirmed. we'll reconvene after 24h of canary telemetry at this thread. :eyes: Thanks everyone.
Carla: ack. I'll post dashboard link when ready. :thumbsup:
